rules: Import from agentic-ds-kit only. Never invent a local cousin.
Read contracts/index.json, then only the matching contract file(s).
Semantic tokens only (no hex, no primitive --color-* ramps in components).
One appearance="solid" mode="primary" Button per view.
Page content in <main>; chrome in header/nav; nav reachable on small screens.
Layout: content inset + gutter 24px (margin-md / gutter-lg). Section does not own page padding.
Compose-or-stop. If a component is missing from the index, ask — do not add a one-off.

--color-.useWhen: Looking up a source hue in the kit palette
--color-.doNot: raw ramps — avoid in components; bind to semantic roles

--bg-.note: Surface ladder from canvas to floating.
--bg-.useWhen: Painting page, wells, cards, fields, or inverse chrome
--bg-.doNot: Do not invent a local fill; pick the matching bg role

--text-.doNot: Do not use primitive color ramps for type

--line-.useWhen: Borders, dividers, and the focus line
--line-.doNot: Do not mix border-* cousins for the same edge if a line role exists

--primary-.note: Brand action fill, brand text (--primary-fg) and subtle well.
--primary-.doNot: Do not hardcode a brand hex in components

--danger-.note: Danger state: fg · base · line · subtle.
--danger-.doNot: Do not use caution/warning tokens for errors

--caution-.doNot: Do not use danger for non-destructive warnings

--success-.doNot: Do not use success as a brand fill

--info-.doNot: Do not use info as the page primary

--highlight-.useWhen: Callouts that are neither success nor caution
--highlight-.doNot: Do not use highlight as warning

--font-.doNot: Do not invent per-component font cousins

--type-size-.useWhen: Matching a heading, ui, body, or overline role
--type-size-.doNot: Do not use rem/px literals in components

--type-line-.note: Line-height paired with the size ladder.
--type-line-.doNot: Do not invent a custom line-height

--type-weight-.useWhen: Body, label, heading, title, metric, caption, overline, code
--type-weight-.doNot: Do not hardcode font-weight numbers in components

--type-family-.note: Aliases of the font trio. --type-family-overline is Plex Mono (alias of --font-mono).
--type-family-.doNot: Do not add a fourth family

--space-.doNot: Do not use magic pixel spacing in components

--radius-.doNot: Do not set a one-off border-radius

--shadow-.note: Elevation: xs inputs, sm cards, md popovers, lg dialogs.
--shadow-.doNot: Do not invent a local box-shadow

--border-.useWhen: Control, surface, divider, or focus width
--border-.doNot: Do not use raw px borders

--motion-.doNot: Do not invent timing functions in components

--opacity-.doNot: Do not use ad-hoc opacity values

--grid-.doNot: Section does not own page padding — use layout classes

--layout-.note: Shell, canvas, content, rail, drawer widths.
--layout-.useWhen: App chrome and content inset (margin-md / gutter-lg 24px)
--layout-.doNot: Do not let Section own page padding

--icon-.note: Icon color roles and stroke width.
--icon-.doNot: Do not hand-roll SVG cousins or set a stroke width other than these tokens

--action-.note: Legacy action aliases of primary and secondary fills.
--action-.doNot: Prefer --primary-* and Button appearance × mode in new work

--surface-.note: Legacy surface aliases of the bg ladder.

--fill-.note: Fill aliases for charts and wells.
--fill-.doNot: Do not use fill as a Button background

--link-.doNot: Do not style kit Buttons as links

--z-.doNot: Do not invent a local stacking context for dialogs

--icon-stroke.doNot: Do not set another stroke width on icons

--icon-stroke-strong.note: Heavier stroke, 2, where 1.5 looks too thin.
--icon-stroke-strong.useWhen: Tiny marks such as the Checkbox check and minus at 12px or smaller
--icon-stroke-strong.doNot: Do not use on regular icons, or on chart, Progress, Meter, or PieChart strokes

--bg-canvas.doNot: Do not fill cards, dialogs, or inputs with canvas

--bg-subtle.doNot: Do not use subtle as the page background

--bg-tray.doNot: Do not use tray as a card face

--bg-surface.doNot: Do not use surface for the page canvas

--bg-raised.note: Same white as surface; semantic step for stacked sheets.
--bg-raised.doNot: Do not invent a third white

--bg-floating.doNot: Do not use floating for inline cards

--bg-field.doNot: Do not use field as a page fill

--bg-control.doNot: Do not use control as a layout background

--text-fg.doNot: Do not use muted for primary copy

--text-fg-muted.doNot: Do not use muted for headings

--text-fg-subtle.note: Tertiary copy. Passes 4.5:1 on surface and canvas only.
--text-fg-subtle.useWhen: Placeholders and tertiary meta on --bg-surface or --bg-canvas
--text-fg-subtle.doNot: Do not use subtle as body text or on --bg-tray (4.34:1 light); use --text-fg-muted there

--text-fg-disabled.doNot: Do not rely on color alone; disable the control

--text-fg-inverse.doNot: Do not use inverse on canvas

--line.doNot: Do not use focus line as a resting border

--line-focus.doNot: Do not remove the focus ring

--primary-base.note: Brand fill. Light Electric Blue brand-500; dark brand-300. data-color="ink" restores black.
--primary-base.doNot: Do not put more than one solid-primary CTA in a view

--primary-fg.note: Brand-coloured text and icons on surface or primary-subtle. Light brand-700; dark blue-200.
--primary-fg.useWhen: Brand labels, selected-item text, text on --primary-subtle wells
--primary-fg.doNot: Do not use --primary-base for small text on --primary-subtle; use --primary-fg

--font-heading.doNot: Do not set a component-local heading font

--font-body.doNot: Do not set a component-local body font

--font-mono.doNot: Do not use mono for body copy

--type-weight-title.useWhen: PageHeader title and other page-level titles
--type-weight-title.doNot: Do not use title weight for section or card headings; use --type-weight-heading

--type-tracking-title.doNot: Do not apply negative tracking to body, label or caption text

--type-tracking-heading.useWhen: Section, Card, dialog and drawer titles set in --type-weight-heading
--type-tracking-heading.doNot: Do not use on text below --type-size-heading

--type-tracking-overline.useWhen: Overlines, eyebrows, group labels, table header cells, metric labels
--type-tracking-overline.doNot: Do not use caps tracking on mixed-case text or body copy

--type-family-overline.note: Overline family: Plex Mono. Always uppercase with --type-tracking-overline.
--type-family-overline.useWhen: Overlines, table header cells, metric labels
--type-family-overline.doNot: Do not use for body copy or values; use --font-mono for code

--action-selected.note: Selected row or item fill. Light primary-subtle (blue-50); dark slate-800. Ink: primary-subtle.
--action-selected.useWhen: Selected table rows, tree and list items
--action-selected.doNot: Do not reuse the hover fill (--surface-muted) for selection

--type-weight-heading.doNot: Do not hardcode a heading weight in a component

--radius-base.doNot: Components use control/surface/media/pill, not the base

--shadow-sm.doNot: Do not invent a local card shadow

--shadow-xs.doNot: Do not use xs on dialogs

--shadow-md.doNot: Do not use md on inline cards

--shadow-lg.doNot: Do not use lg on inputs

--layout-margin-md.doNot: Section does not own page padding

--layout-gutter-lg.doNot: Section does not own page padding

contracts.intent: Design tokens: color, space, radius, type, shadow, and motion primitives with semantic roles.
Clickable action control with appearance × mode (plus an optional flat set) and a fixed set of sizes.
useWhen: Submitting a form or triggering a primary workflow action
Offering a quieter action alongside content (outline, soft, or ghost)
Destructive actions that need explicit danger styling
Toolbar or compact actions with a Lucide icon and a visible label
Icon-only actions when space is tight and ariaLabel names the action
doNotUseWhen: Navigation to another page or site — use Link (inline, standalone or external)
Icon-only without aria-label — icon-only must set ariaLabel
More than one solid-primary button in the same view
doNot: Do not invent local Button appearances or modes outside the enums
Do not use raw hex colors in styles
Do not place more than one appearance=solid mode=primary Button in a single view
Do not pass custom SVG markup as icons — use a Lucide name or Lucide component on iconStart/iconEnd
Do not ship icon-only without ariaLabel

draggable.note: Native drag source. Use with onDragStart/onDragEnd, e.g. a chip that drags into a list.

size.note: Kit sizes. md aligns to Cards medium, sm to small, lg to a larger control.

flat.note: Flat set: no elevation. Combine with solid, outline, or soft (ghost is coerced to soft).

children.note: required unless icon-only

iconStart.note: A curated Lucide name (PascalCase or kebab-case) renders instantly; any other Lucide name needs import "agentic-ds-kit/icons-on-demand" once (otherwise it is skipped with a dev warning). Or pass the Lucide component (Plus) or an element.

iconEnd.note: A curated Lucide name (PascalCase or kebab-case) renders instantly; any other Lucide name needs import "agentic-ds-kit/icons-on-demand" once (otherwise it is skipped with a dev warning). Or pass the Lucide component (Plus) or an element.

shortcut.note: Visual key hint after the label, e.g. "⏎", "Esc", "⌘⏎". aria-hidden: wire the key yourself and set aria-keyshortcuts. Ignored when icon-only.

shape.note: pill uses radius-pill. Drawer footers use pill.

contracts.intent: Joined row of kit Buttons that share one size and act as one control cluster.
useWhen: Related sibling actions such as a view switch
Split confirm/cancel pairs that should read as one cluster
A toolbar of same-size Buttons
doNotUseWhen: Unrelated actions that should stay separate Buttons
Wrapping non-Button controls
Nesting groups
paging a list — use Pagination
doNot: Do not invent a local button group / segmented control
Do not mix sizes inside one group
Do not put more than one appearance=solid mode=primary Button in a group (or the view)
Do not wrap Input, Select, or anything except kit Button
Do not use raw hex

children.note: only kit Button nodes, same size, 2+

contracts.intent: one KPI with label, value, optional delta/trend/hint/badge
useWhen: Showing a single metric such as revenue, users, or conversion rate
doNotUseWhen: Multiple metrics — use Scoreboard
Charts, sparklines, or tables — out of scope for this contract
A framed content tile — use Card
A recommended action tile — use InsightCard
doNot: Do not invent a KpiCard, Stat, or MetricCard cousin
Do not use raw hex colors in styles
Do not pack multiple KPIs into one Scorecard
Do not put buttons or links inside Scorecard besides the whole-card onClick
Do not invent a local Tag or Status on Scorecard — status uses kit Badge via badge

deltaTone.note: Override the delta color (default from trend: up success, down danger). warning (text-warning) for an amber count such as '3 urgent' without a badge that makes the card taller than its neighbours. The icon follows trend; with trend neutral the tone's status icon replaces the dash (TriangleAlert, CircleX, CircleCheck).

badge.note: kit Badge on the header, aligned with label. Compose Badge; status is not a Tag.

onClick.note: When set, the whole card is a button that opens a detail view

selected.note: With onClick: the card is a toggle in a picker (e.g. the metric a chart shows). Sets aria-pressed, draws the selected style (border.brand on action.selected), and adds the badge to the button's name. Leave undefined for a plain button.

fill.note: Stretch to the parent width. Scoreboard passes fill so cards share the row.

contracts.intent: Metrics strip of kit Scorecards. Two to four fill the row; four stay in one row until the strip narrows. More than four compose Conveyor.
useWhen: Showing two or more KPIs side by side at the top of a dashboard
Replacing ad-hoc flex rows of metric boxes
doNotUseWhen: A single KPI — render Scorecard directly
Vertical stacks of metrics — not supported by this contract
doNot: Do not invent a local Scoreboard
Do not fake dividers with CSS borders between items
Do not restyle Scorecard padding or borders inside Scoreboard
Do not inline Scorecard markup — import from ui/Scorecard
More than four items — Scoreboard composes kit Conveyor, do not invent a local scroller
Do not wrap a scrolling Scoreboard in Conveyor — pass scroll={false}

aria-label.note: Names the section (and the Conveyor when scroll is on).

items.note: 2–4 fill equal columns. Four stay four-up until the strip narrows. More than 4 compose kit Conveyor.

scroll.note: false renders the overflow strip without Conveyor so a page can wrap Scoreboard in its own Conveyor.

contracts.intent: Single-line text entry for forms and filters. Optional start and end slots sit inside the field.
useWhen: Collecting short text such as name, email, or search queries
Inside a Field wrapper when label, hint, or error messaging is needed
doNotUseWhen: One-time code or PIN — use InputOTP
Multi-line content — use Textarea
Choosing from fixed options — use Select or RadioGroup
Standalone labeled forms without Field — you must wire label association yourself
doNot: Do not invent local Input variants or InputGroup
Do not use raw hex in styles
Do not use start or end as the accessible name — wrap with Field label
Do not render a separate Lucide icon beside it — pass a Lucide name or component to the icon props

describedBy.note: Id(s) for aria-describedby on the input. Field passes its hint or error id.

start.note: Prefix text inside the field on the left. Not a label.

end.note: Suffix text inside the field on the right. Not a label.

iconStart.note: Left icon. A curated Lucide name (PascalCase or kebab-case) renders instantly; any other Lucide name needs import "agentic-ds-kit/icons-on-demand" once (otherwise it is skipped with a dev warning). Or pass the Lucide component (Plus) or an element.

iconEnd.note: Right icon. A curated Lucide name (PascalCase or kebab-case) renders instantly; any other Lucide name needs import "agentic-ds-kit/icons-on-demand" once (otherwise it is skipped with a dev warning). Or pass the Lucide component (Plus) or an element.

value.note: controlled. When set, do not also rely on defaultValue.

ariaLabel.note: When there is no Field label, such as search inside DropdownMenu.

contracts.intent: A number the person can type, step, and read in their locale, with optional min and max.
useWhen: A quantity, percentage, or other number in a form
The value should format with the locale's grouping and decimal mark
Arrow keys or stepper buttons should move by a step
doNotUseWhen: Money — use CurrencyInput
A rough amount on a track — use Slider
Free text — use Input
doNot: Do not use input type=number when the locale format matters
Do not put a currency symbol on NumberInput — use CurrencyInput
Do not use raw hex

value.note: Controlled. null is empty.

locale.note: BCP 47. Default is the runtime locale.

contracts.intent: A money amount with a currency symbol, locale formatting, min, max, and step.
useWhen: A price, amount, or balance in a form
The symbol and grouping should follow a currency and locale
doNotUseWhen: A plain number — use NumberInput
A currency code the person picks from a list — pair Select with CurrencyInput, do not invent a combined control
doNot: Do not prefix an Input with a currency character
Do not use NumberInput for money
Do not use raw hex

value.note: Controlled. null is empty.

contracts.intent: One-time code / PIN as separate slots. Paste and autocomplete work. Not a row of Inputs.
useWhen: email/SMS verification, PIN, 2FA code
doNotUseWhen: normal text — Input
multi-line — Textarea
choosing options — Select/RadioGroup
doNot: Do not invent InputOTPGroup, InputOTPSlot, or InputOTPSeparator
Do not wrap kit Input N times
Do not add the input-otp package
Do not use raw hex
Do not use Lucide except via LucideByName from @/ui/Button/lucideName
Unlabeled needs Field or ariaLabel

describedBy.note: Id(s) for aria-describedby on the input. Field passes its hint or error id.

groups.note: Slot counts per group; must sum to length. Default [3, 3] when length is 6, else [length]. Separator sits between groups only.

value.note: controlled

ariaLabel.note: required when not wrapped in Field

contracts.intent: A recommended insight or opportunity as a compact card, with tone and optional actions.
useWhen: surface a recommendation, warning, or finding on a dashboard
next to Scorecards when the metric needs a suggested action
doNotUseWhen: one KPI number — Scorecard
login/settings tile — Card
inline page status — Alert
toast — not in kit, ask
doNot: Do not invent local InsightCard, Insight, or RecommendationCard
Do not use raw hex
Do not put a metric as the title (that is Scorecard)
Actions are kit Buttons or the kit text link (href / actionStyle link); do not pass your own links or buttons
Do not make a navigating action a Button — give it href
One primary per view (the primaryAction is the one)

tone.note: Colors the tone icon. success (CircleCheck, icon-success) for good news that is done, e.g. a payment received.

primaryAction.note: kit Button primary (one primary per view), or a text link when it has href or actionStyle is link.

secondaryAction.note: kit Button secondary, or a text link when it has href or actionStyle is link.

actionStyle.note: link: actions render as text links ("View invoice →"): <a> with href, otherwise a button styled as a link. For alert tiles, and when the view's one primary Button is used elsewhere.

onDismiss.note: text Dismiss control, not a Button cousin

contracts.intent: Change and progress over ordered samples as a line or area chart.
useWhen: Following a trajectory across time or sequence
Multi-series trends with shared labels
doNotUseWhen: Comparing unrelated magnitudes at one moment — use BarChart
Part-to-whole share — use PieChart
doNot: Do not invent chart container cousins
Do not use raw hex

curve.note: smooth rounds the line through every point (monotone: no overshoot above peaks or below dips); linear draws straight segments

tickInterval.note: draw every Nth axis label; with neither tickInterval nor formatLabel, labels thin automatically only when they would overlap

formatLabel.note: (label, index) => string for the painted axis label; return '' to hide one (turns off automatic thinning). Table and accessible names keep the raw label

animate.note: Lines draw in left to right and area fills fade in after when the chart first appears. Runs when the chart mounts; changing data on a mounted chart does not replay it. To replay (e.g. one chart per Tabs panel, or a range switcher), give the chart a key that changes with the data. Off under prefers-reduced-motion

contracts.intent: Text that navigates to another page or place: inline inside a sentence, or standalone on its own line, with an external variant that opens a new tab.
useWhen: Navigating to another page, section or site
A link inside running text (inline)
A link on its own line, under a card or in a short list (standalone)
A link that leaves the app (external)
doNotUseWhen: Running an action such as save, delete or open a dialog — use Button
A list of related links with descriptions — use LinkList
Primary site or app navigation — use AppNav, SideNav or NavigationMenu
doNot: Do not use Link for actions; use Button
Do not style a Button to look like a link, or an a to look like a Button
Do not set target=_blank by hand; use external
Do not use raw hex

children.note: The link text. Say where it goes; not "click here".

variant.note: inline: underlined and inherits the surrounding font. standalone: body-sm label weight, underlined on hover.

external.note: Opens in a new tab (target=_blank, rel=noopener noreferrer), shows the ExternalLink icon and adds "(opens in a new tab)" for screen readers.

linkAs.note: Router link to render instead of <a>, e.g. Next.js Link (same KitLinkComponent as Card and Cell). Ignored when external.

contracts.intent: A column of links, one a row with a chevron at the end, like an account's quick links.
useWhen: Quick links in a record's side rail
A few related pages to jump to from a settings or detail page
doNotUseWhen: Actions that change data — use Button or DropdownMenu
Page navigation across the app — use AppNav, SideNav, or Tabs
People, files, or other records one per row — use ListView
A single link in text — use an anchor in body copy
doNot: Do not use it for actions that change data — use Button or DropdownMenu
Do not use it for page navigation across the app — use AppNav or Tabs
Do not put it in a Card or draw a box round it yourself — put it in a Section
Do not build a list of Links or a one-column Table for quick links — use LinkList
Do not use ListView for quick links
Do not pass custom SVG markup as icon — use a Lucide name or Lucide component
Do not use raw hex or primitive --color-* ramps

items.note: The links in order. Keep it short: two to eight.

label.note: Names the list for screen readers, like Quick links.

contracts.intent: A list of records, one row each: primary and optional secondary line, leading avatar or icon, trailing badge, actions, or chevron.
useWhen: People, files, or other records shown one per row
Pick one, check several, or open a row without comparing columns
doNotUseWhen: Values compared across columns — use Table or DataTable
A hierarchy visible at once, more than one level — use TreeView
A list plus a detail pane beside it — use the list-detail pattern
Ordered activity, not a record list — use Timeline
Picking or comparing tiles — use Card
App navigation — use SideNav or AppNav
Only the no-rows state — use Empty
Usage against a plan limit — use UsageList
Quick links in a rail — use LinkList
doNot: Do not use Table or DataTable for a record list without comparable columns
Do not use TreeView — that is a nested hierarchy, more than one level
Do not use the list-detail pattern for the list itself; put detail beside the list
Do not add an in-list detail slot under the selected row
Do not add nested children, path, step-in, or expand-under-row
Do not add drag, reorder, or onItemsChange
Do not add Density or Material Symbols
Do not use LinkList for record rows — LinkList is quick links
Do not invent a local blank slate — empty items render kit Empty
Do not assemble rows from local Cards + Avatars + Buttons; this is the piece
Do not use SideNav or AppNav for a record list
Do not use Timeline for a record list
Do not use Card for picking records in a list
Do not use ListView for usage against a plan limit — use UsageList
Do not use more than two inline row actions — overflow is kit DropdownMenu
Do not place appearance=solid mode=primary Button on a row
Do not use raw hex or primitive --color-* ramps

items.note: Leading media is Avatar when name, src, or initials is set; otherwise Lucide icon; otherwise none. One leading slot. item.group matches groups[].id. At most two trailing actions render as kit Buttons; more go in kit DropdownMenu. Icons: A curated Lucide name (PascalCase or kebab-case) renders instantly; any other Lucide name needs import "agentic-ds-kit/icons-on-demand" once (otherwise it is skipped with a dev warning). Or pass the Lucide component (Plus) or an element.

label.note: Accessible name for the list

selected.note: controlled item ids. Single keeps 0 or 1 id. Ignored when selection is none.

interaction.note: drill shows a trailing chevron and calls onOpen(id). The row body is a button.

onOpen.note: (id: string) => void. Used when interaction is drill.

groups.note: Optional section headers. item.group selects the section.

collapsibleGroups.note: When true, group headers toggle their rows. Expanded by default.

truncate.note: Clip lines to one line with an ellipsis instead of wrapping (e.g. long emails in a narrow rail wrap mid-word otherwise). secondary clips the secondary line; both also the primary. The full text stays in the row's accessible name and the hover title.

empty.note: When items is [], ListView renders kit Empty. title is required.

contracts.intent: Square dot-grid loading indicator for compact waits.
useWhen: Panel or card content is loading
Short blocking fetches inside a region
doNotUseWhen: Assistant thinking state — use ThinkingAnimation
Determinate progress — use Progress
doNot: Do not use raw hex

contracts.intent: How far along or how full something is, from 0 to 100, as a bar, a ring, or a half ring, with optional red, amber, and green zones.
useWhen: Task completion with a known percent: uploads, imports, onboarding — when you need zones, a datatip, or indeterminate
A measure against a range, like storage, budget, or a score, where red, amber, and green zones help people judge it
A color the screen decides, like a usage limit going amber and red: set intent
doNotUseWhen: Simple determinate task completion without zones — use Progress
Usage against a plan limit as labeled rows — use UsageList
A short wait of unknown length in the spot that is loading — use Spinner
Placeholder layout while data arrives — use Skeleton
Part-to-whole share across segments — use PieChart
doNot: Do not use it for a short wait of unknown length in the spot that is loading — show a Spinner
Do not use indeterminate with circle or semicircle; it is bar only
Do not draw bars or rings from divs or SVG — use Meter or Progress
Do not add a MeterLabel, MeterCircle, or ProgressCircle — pick shape
Do not use intent and thresholds bar together — intent wins; pick one
Do not rely on the zone colors alone; say what the value means in the label, showValue, or datatip
Do not use Meter for simple determinate completion without zones — use Progress
Do not skip prefers-reduced-motion on the indeterminate slide
Do not use raw hex or primitive --color-* ramps

value.note: 0 to 100. Values outside are clamped. indeterminate is for work whose amount done is not known: a short segment slides along a bar, with no percent. Bar only.

label.note: Names it for screen readers, like Storage used.

shape.note: bar fills its container's width. circle is a ring that fills clockwise from the top. semicircle is a bowl: 0 to 100 runs from its left tip, under, to its right tip.

size.note: Bar: space-1 / space-2 / space-3 tall. Circle and semicircle: 56 / 96 / 196 wide.

thresholds.note: Zones are thirds: under 33 is red, under 67 amber, the rest green. none: brand (ink) value on a muted track. bar: the value takes its zone's color. plotArea: the track takes the value's zone color under a brand value. all: the track shows all three bands under a brand value.

intent.note: Sets the value's color outright, whatever thresholds says, when the screen knows what the value means. Leave it out for the brand (ink) value or the threshold zones.

referenceLines.note: Marks at the zone edges, a third and two thirds along.

showValue.note: The rounded percent: after the bar, or inside the ring.

datatip.note: A short note in a tip at the end of the value, like $6,000 of $10,000.

contracts.intent: Multi-line text entry for notes and descriptions. Wrap with Field.
useWhen: Paragraphs, notes, or descriptions
Inside Field when label, hint, or error are required
doNotUseWhen: Single-line values — use Input
One-time code — use InputOTP
Rich text or markdown editing — out of scope
doNot: Do not invent local Textarea
Do not bake Field label or hint into Textarea — wrap with Field
Do not add start/icon slots — those are Input
Do not use raw hex

describedBy.note: Id(s) for aria-describedby on the textarea. Field passes its hint or error id.

rows.note: optional native rows; height also comes from size

value.note: controlled. When set, do not also rely on defaultValue.

contracts.intent: Pick a time of day as hour and minute, in 12-hour or 24-hour form.
useWhen: A time in a form, without a date
Arrow keys should move the hour or the minute
doNotUseWhen: A date and a time together — use DateTimePicker
A date only — use DatePicker
doNot: Do not use input type=time
Do not store 12-hour text — the value is HH:mm
Do not use raw hex

value.note: Controlled HH:mm in 24-hour form.

contracts.intent: Choose one or several options from a list. Field trigger, kit DropdownMenu panel. Not a native select.
useWhen: Choosing one value in a Field
Choosing several values from a list (multiple)
A long fixed list with local search (searchable)
Short fixed lists such as month, year, timezone, or tags
doNotUseWhen: Command palettes — use Command
Actions from a button — use DropdownMenu
Mutually exclusive choices with visible options — prefer RadioGroup
Typed or async search — use Combobox
Removable tags with an inline filter — use MultiSelect
Tags the person types — use TagInput
doNot: Do not use a native select
Do not use kit Button as the Select trigger — Select uses DropdownMenu triggerStyle=field
Do not invent SelectTrigger, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectValue, or SelectGroup
Do not invent a local overflow chip — overflow count is kit Badge
Do not render Tags inside the trigger button or add a local chip list — use valueDisplay=tags
Do not use raw hex
Do not use for navigation — use AppNav or links

describedBy.note: Id(s) for aria-describedby on the trigger button. Field passes its hint or error id.

multiple.note: Several values. Menu stays open. Checks each pick. Trigger lists labels. A field of tags with an inline filter is MultiSelect.

placeholder.note: Shown until a value is picked. Muted field text. When set and no defaultValue, start empty.
